BiblicalUsage: Joelah is named once, in 1 Chronicles 12:7. In 1 Chronicles 12:7 we read, "And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor."
TheologicalSignificance: Joelah is on God's list, and I believe he writes down names the world would leave out.
